title: 污水管渠硫化氫腐蝕控制~Hydrogen-sulfide corrosion control in sewers
focus: 硫化物生成、逸散、腐蝕證據與控制邊界~Sulfide generation, release, corrosion evidence and control boundaries
summary: 本課以硫化物生成、逸散、腐蝕證據與控制邊界為主線，從厭氧停留與來源、總硫化物水相負荷、pH 與水相分配、跌水逸散與氣相量測進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops sulfide generation, release, corrosion evidence and control boundaries through ten connected units, beginning with anaerobic retention and sources, total aqueous sulfide load, ph and aqueous speciation, release at drops and gas monitoring. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 厭氧停留與來源~Anaerobic retention and sources
units.mechanism: 有機物與硫酸鹽在缺氧管段可形成硫化物；先畫長停留區、壓力管及跌水點，再談控制。~Organic matter and sulfate can support sulfide formation in anaerobic reaches; map retention zones, force mains and drops before selecting control.
units.model: 原創教學假設：V=1500 m³；Q=3000 m³/d。模型 θ=24V/Q，代入得到 12 h。適用邊界：名義水力停留時間；不包含短流、死角及回流的停留時間分布。~Original teaching assumptions: V=1500 m³; Q=3000 m³/d. Model θ=24V/Q gives 12 h. Applicability: Nominal hydraulic residence time; it does not resolve short-circuiting, dead zones or recirculation residence-time distributions.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「厭氧停留與來源」的觀測點。以槽有效容積與示蹤劑穿透曲線交叉檢查。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for anaerobic retention and sources. Cross-check effective volume with a tracer breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只檢查臭味出口而未追溯上游生成區。診斷與介入：用示蹤曲線及有效容積修正假設，先在模擬中比較分流方案。~Only the odor outlet is checked, leaving upstream generation unmapped. Diagnostic response: Revise assumptions using tracing/effective volume and compare flow-distribution options in simulation first.
units.misconception: 腐蝕只能在聞到臭味的位置開始。~Corrosion can begin only where odor is noticed.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:3000→3600 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 12 變為 10 h。用「厭氧停留與來源」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:3000→3600 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 12 to 10 h. Explain the direction using anaerobic retention and sources, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 總硫化物水相負荷~Total aqueous sulfide load
units.mechanism: 先統一硫質量基準，採樣保存不當會讓氧化或揮發被誤認為真去除。~Use a common sulfur-mass basis; poor sample preservation can make oxidation or volatilization appear to be treatment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=800 m³/d；總溶解硫化物=4 mg S/L。模型 LS=QC/1000，代入得到 3.2 kg S/d。適用邊界：硫基準水相負荷，不是空氣中 H2S 濃度；採樣須避免氧化與揮發損失。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=800 m³/d; total dissolved sulfide=4 mg S/L. Model LS=QC/1000 gives 3.2 kg S/d. Applicability: Aqueous sulfur-basis load, not airborne H2S concentration; sampling must prevent oxidation and volatilization loss.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「總硫化物水相負荷」的觀測點。採樣保存與分析方法成對記錄，對比流量加權樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for total aqueous sulfide load. Record preservation and analytical methods together and compare flow-weighted samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 硫與 H2S 分子質量混用。診斷與介入：核對保存、氧化及揮發損失，重新建立硫質量基準。~Sulfur mass and H2S molecular mass are mixed. Diagnostic response: Check preservation, oxidation and volatilization losses and rebuild the sulfur basis.
units.misconception: 相同數字的 mg S/L 與 mg H2S/L 等價。~Equal numerical mg S/L and mg H2S/L values are equivalent.
units.practice: 只改變 C:4→6 mg S/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 3.2 變為 4.8 kg S/d。用「總硫化物水相負荷」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:4→6 mg S/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 3.2 to 4.8 kg S/d. Explain the direction using total aqueous sulfide load, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: pH 與水相分配~pH and aqueous speciation
units.mechanism: 未解離 H2S 比例受 pH 與溫度影響；此平衡不會直接給出呼吸高度的氣體濃度。~The undissociated H2S fraction depends on pH and temperature; aqueous equilibrium does not directly give breathing-zone concentration.
units.model: 原創教學假設：總溶解硫化物=5 mg S/L；pH=7；假設 pKa1=7。模型 H2S-S=ST/(1+10^(pH-pKa))，代入得到 2.5 mg S/L。適用邊界：忽略第二解離及非理想活度；不是空氣 H2S 濃度或安全判定。~Original teaching assumptions: Total dissolved sulfide=5 mg S/L; pH=7; assumed pKa1=7. Model H2S-S=ST/(1+10^(pH-pKa)) gives 2.5 mg S/L. Applicability: Neglects second dissociation/nonideal activity; it is neither airborne H2S nor a safety determination.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「pH 與水相分配」的觀測點。以封閉自動取樣資料比較 pH、硫化物與氣相讀值；不進入管渠。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for ph and aqueous speciation. Compare closed automated samples for pH/sulfide with gas readings; do not enter sewers. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把水相 H2S 算式當作空氣安全證明。診斷與介入：校正水相 pH、溫度及保存方法，另用氣相量測判讀逸散。~An aqueous-H2S calculation is used as proof of air safety. Diagnostic response: Correct aqueous pH, temperature and preservation, using separate gas measurements for release.
units.misconception: 水相硫化物低就不需要氣體量測。~Low aqueous sulfide removes the need for gas measurement.
units.practice: 只改變 pH:7→8，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2.5 變為 0.45454545 mg S/L。用「pH 與水相分配」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only pH:7→8, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2.5 to 0.45454545 mg S/L. Explain the direction using ph and aqueous speciation, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 跌水逸散與氣相量測~Release at drops and gas monitoring
units.mechanism: 紊流、溫度與氣液接觸會影響逸散；氣相負荷需由同時的風量與濃度計算。~Turbulence, temperature and gas-liquid contact affect release; gas load needs simultaneous airflow and concentration.
units.model: 原創教學假設：氣體流量=500 m³/h；濃度=20 mg/m³。模型 M=QC/1000000，代入得到 0.01 kg/h。適用邊界：氣體體積與濃度須在同一溫壓基準；不可把 mg/m³ 當 ppm。~Original teaching assumptions: Gas flow=500 m³/h; concentration=20 mg/m³. Model M=QC/1000000 gives 0.01 kg/h. Applicability: Gas volume and concentration require the same temperature/pressure basis; mg/m³ is not ppm.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「跌水逸散與氣相量測」的觀測點。同步量氣體流量、溫壓及成分，確認採樣代表性。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for release at drops and gas monitoring. Synchronize gas flow, temperature, pressure and composition and verify representative sampling. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 不同溫壓條件的氣體數字直接相乘。診斷與介入：統一溫壓與成分單位，再配對風量與濃度。~Gas measurements from different reference conditions are multiplied directly. Diagnostic response: Unify temperature/pressure and composition units before pairing flow/concentration.
units.misconception: 氣體 ppm 可直接代入 mg/m³ 的質量式。~Gas ppm can be directly substituted for mg/m³.
units.practice: 只改變 C:20→30 mg/m³，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.01 變為 0.015 kg/h。用「跌水逸散與氣相量測」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:20→30 mg/m³, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.01 to 0.015 kg/h. Explain the direction using release at drops and gas monitoring, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 冠部酸蝕與材料損失~Crown acid attack and material loss
units.mechanism: 潮濕管冠的生物氧化可能造成酸蝕；用連續厚度與表面紀錄辨識進展，而非單張照片。~Biological oxidation on a damp crown can cause acid attack; track thickness and surface condition over time, not a single image.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假想試片厚度減少=0.6 mm；觀察=2 yr。模型 r=Δh/t，代入得到 0.3 mm/yr。適用邊界：線性平均不保證未來速率；局部腐蝕與結構強度須另評估。~Original teaching assumptions: Hypothetical coupon thickness loss=0.6 mm; observation=2 yr. Model r=Δh/t gives 0.3 mm/yr. Applicability: Linear average does not predict future rate; local attack and structural strength need separate assessment.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「冠部酸蝕與材料損失」的觀測點。對照多點厚度、材料、含濕與酸性表面紀錄。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for crown acid attack and material loss. Compare multiple thickness points, material, moisture and acidic-surface records. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 沉積層厚度被當作完整結構厚度。診斷與介入：重測同點及鄰近材料厚度，保留局部失效與結構評估。~Deposit thickness is confused with sound structural thickness. Diagnostic response: Remeasure matched/adjacent thickness and retain localized-failure/structural assessment.
units.misconception: 外觀沒有破洞就沒有腐蝕損失。~No visible hole means no corrosion loss.
units.practice: 只改變 Δh:0.6→0.8 mm，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.3 變為 0.4 mm/yr。用「冠部酸蝕與材料損失」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Δh:0.6→0.8 mm, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.3 to 0.4 mm/yr. Explain the direction using crown acid attack and material loss, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 通風與密閉空間邊界~Ventilation and confined-space boundaries
units.mechanism: 換氣次數只描述平均空氣交換；死角、持續產氣與感測位置仍決定暴露。遊戲不提供入井許可。~Air changes describe average exchange; dead zones, continuing generation and sensor placement govern exposure. The game grants no confined-space entry authorization.
units.model: 原創教學假設：空間=100 m³；換氣量=500 m³/h。模型 ACH=Qair/V，代入得到 5 h⁻¹。適用邊界：均勻混合假設；換氣次數不能證明毒氣或缺氧環境安全。~Original teaching assumptions: Space=100 m³; ventilation=500 m³/h. Model ACH=Qair/V gives 5 h⁻¹. Applicability: Well-mixed assumption; air changes do not establish safety from toxic gas or oxygen deficiency.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「通風與密閉空間邊界」的觀測點。在模型上比對送排風位置與氣體感測覆蓋，操作僅限模擬。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for ventilation and confined-space boundaries. Compare supply/exhaust placement and gas-sensor coverage in simulation only. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以鼻子是否聞到判斷 H2S 是否存在。診斷與介入：查實測風量、死角及持續產氣；密閉空間程序不能以此比值取代。~Smell is used to decide whether H2S is present. Diagnostic response: Check airflow, dead zones and continuing generation; the ratio does not replace confined-space procedures.
units.misconception: 計算換氣次數足夠就可自行入井。~A calculated air-change rate authorizes entry.
units.practice: 只改變 Qair:500→400 m³/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 5 變為 4 h⁻¹。用「通風與密閉空間邊界」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qair:500→400 m³/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 5 to 4 h⁻¹. Explain the direction using ventilation and confined-space boundaries, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 源頭控制方案比較~Comparing source-control options
units.mechanism: 比較縮短停留、降低生成、捕集與化學處理的邊界；質量換算不能替代現場試驗及副作用評估。~Compare retention reduction, generation control, capture and chemical treatment boundaries; mass conversion does not replace site trials or side-effect assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；假設活性成分 D=5 mg/L。模型 M=QD/1000，代入得到 10 kg active/d。適用邊界：僅單位換算示例，不是推薦劑量；藥液濃度須另換算。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; assumed active-component dose D=5 mg/L. Model M=QD/1000 gives 10 kg active/d. Applicability: Unit-conversion example only, not a recommended dose; solution concentration requires separate conversion.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「源頭控制方案比較」的觀測點。以藥液消耗稱重與處理水量交叉核對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for comparing source-control options. Cross-check weighed reagent consumption against treated flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只看臭味變少而未量總硫及下游影響。診斷與介入：核對活性成分、流量和投加量換算，避免把示例作為推薦設定。~Reduced odor is accepted without sulfur or downstream checks. Diagnostic response: Check active strength, flow and dosing conversion; do not use the example as a recommended setting.
units.misconception: 任何去味處理都會把硫元素消失。~Every odor-control process makes sulfur disappear.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:2000→2500 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 10 變為 12.5 kg active/d。用「源頭控制方案比較」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:2000→2500 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 10 to 12.5 kg active/d. Explain the direction using comparing source-control options, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 內襯與檢查覆蓋~Lining and inspection coverage
units.mechanism: 保護層連續性、接縫與基底狀況影響耐久性；遠端檢查須標出未覆蓋面積。~Lining continuity, joints and substrate condition affect durability; remote inspection must identify unexamined area.
units.model: 原創教學假設：已檢查管內壁面積=60 m²；目標面積=100 m²。模型 coverage=Ainspected/Atarget，代入得到 0.6 fraction。適用邊界：只表示檢查覆蓋率；未檢查區域不能假定完好。~Original teaching assumptions: Inspected internal surface=60 m²; target area=100 m². Model coverage=Ainspected/Atarget gives 0.6 fraction. Applicability: Inspection coverage only; uninspected regions cannot be assumed sound.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「內襯與檢查覆蓋」的觀測點。將遠端影像、厚度測點與管段里程對齊，標示遮蔽區。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for lining and inspection coverage. Align remote imagery and thickness measurements to chainage and mark occluded regions. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 有影像的區域完好便推定全管完好。診斷與介入：補上遮蔽及未測區域，避免以部分影像推定全線完好。~Sound photographed areas are taken as proof that the whole pipe is sound. Diagnostic response: Add occluded/unmeasured regions rather than inferring whole-line condition from partial images.
units.misconception: 檢查覆蓋率等於腐蝕防護有效率。~Inspection coverage equals corrosion-protection effectiveness.
units.practice: 只改變 Ainspected:60→80 m²，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.6 變為 0.8 fraction。用「內襯與檢查覆蓋」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Ainspected:60→80 m², holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.6 to 0.8 fraction. Explain the direction using lining and inspection coverage, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 處理床穿透監測~Treatment-bed breakthrough
units.mechanism: 氣相吸附或反應床需追蹤床前後同成分比例；處理效率與人員暴露判定各有量測邊界。~Track matching upstream/downstream gas species across adsorption/reactive beds; treatment efficiency and exposure have separate monitoring boundaries.
units.model: 原創教學假設：入口 C0=100 mg/m³；出口 C=10 mg/m³。模型 B=C/C0，代入得到 0.1 fraction。適用邊界：同溫壓同成分的氣相穿透比，不是職業暴露或燃氣品質合格判定。~Original teaching assumptions: Inlet C0=100 mg/m³; outlet C=10 mg/m³. Model B=C/C0 gives 0.1 fraction. Applicability: Gas breakthrough ratio for the same species and volume basis, not occupational-exposure or fuel-quality compliance.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「處理床穿透監測」的觀測點。比對床前床後同時採樣與氣體分析校正。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for treatment-bed breakthrough. Compare simultaneous upstream/downstream samples and gas-analyzer calibration. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只量出口但未知道入口負荷上升。診斷與介入：同步測入口與出口氣體成分，另檢查環境暴露監測。~Only the outlet is measured, hiding rising inlet load. Diagnostic response: Measure matching inlet/outlet gases and separately check ambient-exposure monitoring.
units.misconception: 去除九成就必定符合所有排放與暴露要求。~Ninety-percent removal meets every emission and exposure requirement.
units.practice: 只改變 C:10→25 mg/m³，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.1 變為 0.25 fraction。用「處理床穿透監測」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:10→25 mg/m³, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.1 to 0.25 fraction. Explain the direction using treatment-bed breakthrough, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 腐蝕控制成效回訪~Follow-up of corrosion control
units.mechanism: 以相同管段、季節條件及測點比較硫負荷、氣相與材料損失，辨識改善是否持續。~Compare sulfide load, gas and material loss at matched reaches, seasons and points to determine whether improvement persists.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假想試片厚度減少=0.6 mm；觀察=2 yr。模型 r=Δh/t，代入得到 0.3 mm/yr。適用邊界：線性平均不保證未來速率；局部腐蝕與結構強度須另評估。~Original teaching assumptions: Hypothetical coupon thickness loss=0.6 mm; observation=2 yr. Model r=Δh/t gives 0.3 mm/yr. Applicability: Linear average does not predict future rate; local attack and structural strength need separate assessment.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「腐蝕控制成效回訪」的觀測點。對照多點厚度、材料、含濕與酸性表面紀錄。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for follow-up of corrosion control. Compare multiple thickness points, material, moisture and acidic-surface records. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 短期低臭味被當作多年壽命保證。診斷與介入：重測同點及鄰近材料厚度，保留局部失效與結構評估。~Short-term odor reduction is treated as a multiyear life guarantee. Diagnostic response: Remeasure matched/adjacent thickness and retain localized-failure/structural assessment.
units.misconception: 歷史平均腐蝕速率可以無條件預測剩餘壽命。~Historical mean corrosion rate unconditionally predicts remaining life.
units.practice: 只改變 Δh:0.6→0.8 mm，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.3 變為 0.4 mm/yr。用「腐蝕控制成效回訪」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Δh:0.6→0.8 mm, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.3 to 0.4 mm/yr. Explain the direction using follow-up of corrosion control, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
